newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE nearby white sugar edges higher with NY rall.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE nearby white sugar edges higher with NY rall.

text.p: White sugar futures managed to claw back some of the ground lost earlier in the day as the firmness in the New York market kept London away from session lows, traders said on Monday.
The spot August contract slid below support at $320 in the morning on trade-led selling but quickly found the strength to push higher once the bullish tone in New York asserted itself.
But sellers, some of whom were reported to be funds, kept a lid on thge rally and nearby London prices still had tough going regaining their opening levels
"It's not bad volume, it looks like there's a bit of fund selling," said one trader.
At 1610 GMT August was down $1.00 at $320.20 after moving in a range of $1.70. October stood 20 cents lower at $315.10 and was said to be well supported at $314.00.
Volume was dominated by August and totalled a solid 2,410 lots, including a fair sprinkling of crosses and August/October trades.
Technically, August is sliding down a trendline extending from the $330.80 high scored at the start of this month and analysts said its recent weakness could be a sign of a market reversal.

While the market was currently supported around $320, if prices were to close below that point then $315 could soon be tested, they said. The market's outlook would improve if $325 resistance were broken.
Trading was tightly mixed in Paris where 564 lots were traded. August was down 30 cents at $320.00 and October up 20 cents at $315.00.
On the Matif exchange's new 100 ICUMSA contract 170 lots were traded. October was down $3.00 at $291.50.
